title: Dogfood chain carries capability tags on every requirement
description: User story under REQ-171. the maintainer of the rcf-lite dogfood chain every REQ under rcf-lite/rcf to carry at least one capability:<slug> tag drawn from the documented taxonomy
asA: the maintainer of the rcf-lite dogfood chain
iWant: every REQ under rcf-lite/rcf to carry at least one capability:<slug> tag drawn from the documented taxonomy
soThat: the by-capability Product Map view has something to bucket on, and the trial can be evaluated against real data rather than a fixture

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every REQ under packages/rcf-lite/rcf/requirements/ carries at least one tag matching the regex ^capability:[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, and every slug used maps to an entry in the documented capability taxonomy.
